name: CAP-Gly domain containing linker protein 1

function.text: CLIP1 encodes CAP-Gly domain-containing linker protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include microtubule binding and tubulin binding. It participates in cytoplasmic microtubule organization and microtubule bundle formation.
